title: User Interface Advanced Concepts - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of advanced user interface concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of responsive design in PEGA applications?
questions.explanation: Responsive design ensures consistent user experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices by automatically adapting layouts and interfaces.

questions.question: Which WCAG 2.1 guideline level should enterprise applications typically target?
questions.explanation: Level AA is the recommended standard for most enterprise applications, providing good accessibility without being overly restrictive.

questions.question: How do you implement conditional UI visibility in PEGA?
options: Using visibility conditions on sections and layouts
questions.explanation: Conditional UI visibility is implemented using visibility conditions on sections, layouts, and individual UI elements based on data values or user actions.

questions.question: What is the recommended color contrast ratio for normal text under WCAG 2.1?
questions.explanation: WCAG 2.1 requires a minimum color contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text to ensure readability for users with visual impairments.

questions.question: Which approach is best for creating reusable UI components?
questions.explanation: Creating templates and fragments allows you to build reusable UI components that can be consistently applied across multiple sections and applications.

questions.question: How should you handle keyboard navigation for accessibility?
options: Implement tab order and keyboard shortcuts
questions.explanation: Proper keyboard navigation requires implementing logical tab order, keyboard shortcuts, and focus indicators to support users who cannot use a mouse.

questions.question: What is the purpose of skin rules in PEGA?
options: To define consistent visual styling and themes
questions.explanation: Skin rules define consistent visual styling, themes, and CSS for applications, ensuring uniform appearance across all interfaces.

questions.question: Which CSS technique is most efficient for responsive layouts?
questions.explanation: CSS Grid and Flexbox provide the most efficient and flexible approach for creating responsive layouts that adapt to different screen sizes.
